purpose: Current operational state for a session picking up the hourly cycle. STATE ONLY - parser history belongs in docs/accuracy-log.md and priorities in CLAUDE.md. If a key here cannot be re-verified in under a minute, it should not be here.
rewritten: 2026-09-11 - the previous version carried 135 keys last maintained in August, and several read as live instructions that were false. The worst was partialDataWarning:'ACTIVE ... DO NOT MIRROR', describing a cancelled run from #175 while the branch held a complete v123 store: a stale state file does not merely go unread, it BLOCKS correct action. mainVersion said v89 when main was v123. Nothing reads this file programmatically; it misleads humans and sessions only.
howToUseThis: Verify before trusting. git fetch + scripts/mirror.sh answer the git questions; docs/coverage-history.jsonl answers the coverage questions; the Actions run list answers what is in flight. This file is a pointer, not an authority.
scheduler: MCP Routine 'wampo hourly cycle (self-bind)' (trig_017vdX5dSSYh5v68Cwe6EUBu) wakes the owning session hourly at :07. Fresh-session Routines are DEAD - they get no repo source and no push credential. See docs/hourly-cycle-prompt.md.
chainArmingRetired: cadenceFireAt / watchdogFireAt / knownExtraChains are GONE. They gated a send_later chain that re-armed itself, and the Routine replaced it. Do not re-introduce them: the chain-multiplication problem they existed to solve only exists if something arms chains.
queue: There is no separate task queue. The hourly cycle takes its next item from CLAUDE.md - the residuals table's `reachable` column for parser work, the owner-decision list for what must NOT be started unasked. CLAUDE.md said this file was the queue; it never has been, and that line is corrected in the same commit.
ownerDecisionsOpen: GitHub Pages must serve main (Settings -> Pages) - last blocker on 'live'

Match vs menus: ~1,634 plans / ~2.9M participants reachable locally with no downloads, vs 8.4M behind a pipeline pass, vs ~100 reachable fund-menu plans. Measured both sides 2026-09-11; the call is the owner's and no session should start it unasked (0 path defects in 120 sampled = new coverage, not a repair).
doNotRefix: Two classes measured and deliberately unfixed, evidence in docs/wampo-gap-inventory.md: comparative-statement class labels (3,091 confident entries, mostly real holdings); issuer-wrap around fund names (249 rows/187 confident, but the repair destroys 'Lifetime' and 'Growth & Income'). Also: do NOT lower funds.length >= 3 - measured 2026-09-11, ~87% of the `few` bucket has nothing publishable and the floor is what keeps parse wreckage off the site.
standingHazards: Never push scripts/** or the workflow while a build-data run is in flight (concurrency cancels it). Mirror ONLY with scripts/mirror.sh. Read stores through scripts/lib-schema.mjs. Verify both that a run STARTED and what its conclusion was - site-test was red for ten runs because only the former was checked.
retiredKeysArchivedIn: git history - this file's pre-2026-09-11 revisions hold the v69-v89 era notes, and docs/accuracy-log.md holds every parser version permanently.
